title: Site Reliability Engineer Deep‑Dive Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to master SRE fundamentals, core engineering practices, showcase real‑world projects, and prepare for senior‑level roles. Focuses on depth, best‑practice tooling, and professional habits.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build a solid base in Linux, networking, and core programming concepts.

milestones.title: Linux system fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can navigate, configure, and troubleshoot a Linux server confidently.

tasks.title: Read Linux Filesystem Hierarchy
tasks.description: Study the FHS page on the Linux Documentation Project and note key directories.

tasks.title: Set up a VM with Ubuntu Server
tasks.description: Create a virtual machine, install Ubuntu Server, and enable SSH access.

tasks.title: Practice basic commands
tasks.description: Run ls, cat, grep, systemctl, and journalctl to explore system state.

tasks.title: Configure static IP
tasks.description: Edit /etc/netplan to assign a static address and verify connectivity.

tasks.title: Reflect on command shortcuts
tasks.description: Write a short note on which commands saved you time and why.

milestones.title: Networking basics for reliability
milestones.outcome: Can diagnose common network issues and understand TCP/IP fundamentals.

tasks.title: Watch TCP/IP overview on YouTube
tasks.description: Select a reputable channel (e.g., Computerphile) and watch the 15‑minute TCP/IP video.

tasks.title: Read TCP/IP chapter on MDN
tasks.description: Read the MDN article on IP addressing and subnetting, taking notes on CIDR notation.

tasks.title: Configure iptables firewall
tasks.description: Create a simple allow‑only‑SSH rule and test connection from another VM.

tasks.title: Use ping and traceroute
tasks.description: Run ping and traceroute to a public host, record latency and hops.

tasks.title: Connect with a networking forum
tasks.description: Post a question about a subtle routing issue on Stack Overflow or Server Fault and engage with answers.

milestones.title: Programming fundamentals for automation
milestones.outcome: Can write scripts to automate routine SRE tasks.

tasks.title: Complete Python basics on freeCodeCamp
tasks.description: Finish the first 3 sections (variables, control flow, functions) and run the exercises.

tasks.title: Write a log‑parsing script
tasks.description: Create a Python script that reads syslog, filters error lines, and outputs a summary.

tasks.title: Practice exception handling
tasks.description: Add try/except blocks to handle missing files and malformed lines.

tasks.title: Review code style with Pylint
tasks.description: Run pylint on your script and fix at least three warnings.

tasks.title: Reflect on automation impact
tasks.description: Write a brief note on how scripting reduces manual toil.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop observability, incident response, and reliability engineering practices.

milestones.title: Observability stack basics
milestones.outcome: Can deploy and query metrics, logs, and traces using open‑source tools.

tasks.title: Read Prometheus architecture on docs
tasks.description: Study the official Prometheus documentation overview page.

tasks.title: Install Prometheus on Docker
tasks.description: Run a Docker container with Prometheus, configure a node exporter, and verify metrics appear.

tasks.title: Create a Grafana dashboard
tasks.description: Add Grafana, connect to Prometheus, and build a simple CPU/Memory dashboard.

tasks.title: Practice alert rule creation
tasks.description: Define a rule that fires when CPU > 80% for 2 minutes and test it.

tasks.title: Connect with Grafana community
tasks.description: Join the Grafana Slack channel and ask a question about alert routing.

milestones.title: Incident management workflow
milestones.outcome: Can lead an incident from detection through resolution and post‑mortem.

tasks.title: Read Google SRE incident guide
tasks.description: Study the incident response chapter on the SRE book website.

tasks.title: Set up a mock incident page
tasks.description: Create a Confluence‑style page template for incident tracking.

tasks.title: Practice run a simulated outage
tasks.description: Trigger a service stop, follow the runbook, and record timestamps for each step.

tasks.title: Write a short post‑mortem draft
tasks.description: Summarize cause, impact, and remediation in 300 words.

tasks.title: Reflect on communication style
tasks.description: Note three improvements for future incident briefings.

milestones.title: Designing and measuring SLOs
milestones.outcome: Can define, monitor, and evaluate Service Level Objectives for a service.

tasks.title: Read SLO chapter from Google SRE book
tasks.description: Focus on error budget concepts and read the relevant section online.

tasks.title: Identify key service metrics
tasks.description: List latency, availability, and error rate metrics for a sample web service.

tasks.title: Calculate an error budget
tasks.description: Using a 99.9% availability target, compute the allowable downtime per month.

tasks.title: Configure SLO alerts in Prometheus
tasks.description: Create a recording rule for error budget burn rate and an alert for >80% consumption.

tasks.title: Connect with SRE meetup group
tasks.description: Attend a virtual meetup and discuss real‑world SLO challenges.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that demonstrate end‑to‑end reliability engineering.

milestones.title: Monitoring stack with alerts
milestones.outcome: Can showcase a full monitoring pipeline from data collection to alerting.

tasks.title: Plan stack architecture
tasks.description: Sketch components (node exporter, Prometheus, Alertmanager, Grafana) on paper or a diagram tool.

tasks.title: Deploy stack on cloud VM
tasks.description: Use Terraform (free) to provision a VM and install all components via scripts.

tasks.title: Create three meaningful alerts
tasks.description: Define alerts for CPU, disk space, and HTTP error rate, and test each.

tasks.title: Document setup in README
tasks.description: Write clear instructions, diagrams, and screenshots for future viewers.

tasks.title: Share project on GitHub
tasks.description: Push the repo, add a descriptive tag, and post a short summary on LinkedIn.

milestones.title: Load test and capacity report
milestones.outcome: Can perform load testing, analyze results, and recommend scaling actions.

tasks.title: Read k6 getting‑started guide
tasks.description: Follow the official k6 docs to install and run a basic script.

tasks.title: Write a load test script
tasks.description: Target a sample REST endpoint, simulate 1000 virtual users, and capture latency.

tasks.title: Run test and collect metrics
tasks.description: Execute the script, export results to CSV, and note peak RPS and errors.

tasks.title: Draft a capacity report
tasks.description: Summarize findings, plot graphs, and suggest CPU/instance scaling thresholds.

tasks.title: Get feedback from a peer
tasks.description: Post the report in a dev community and ask for critique.

milestones.title: Simulated outage post‑mortem
milestones.outcome: Can produce a professional post‑mortem that highlights root cause and improvements.

tasks.title: Design a failure scenario
tasks.description: Choose a service (e.g., database) and outline steps to cause a controlled outage.

tasks.title: Execute the scenario in a sandbox
tasks.description: Trigger the failure, capture logs, and note detection time.

tasks.title: Write a detailed post‑mortem
tasks.description: Follow the SRE post‑mortem template, include timeline, analysis, and action items.

tasks.title: Create an improvement backlog
tasks.description: List at least three concrete changes to prevent recurrence.

tasks.title: Present the post‑mortem to a mentor
tasks.description: Schedule a short video call and walk through the document, noting feedback.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance to distributed systems, polish professional habits, and prepare for job or client interviews.

milestones.title: Distributed systems concepts
milestones.outcome: Can explain consistency, replication, and fault tolerance in modern services.

tasks.title: Read CAP theorem article on Wikipedia
tasks.description: Summarize the three guarantees and real‑world trade‑offs in 150 words.

tasks.title: Watch Consul service mesh intro
tasks.description: View the HashiCorp video and note how service discovery works.

tasks.title: Deploy a simple Raft demo
tasks.description: Run the etcd Docker image, add a second node, and observe leader election.

tasks.title: Write a comparison table
tasks.description: Contrast at‑least three data stores (e.g., MySQL, Cassandra, Redis) on consistency models.

tasks.title: Reflect on reliability implications
tasks.description: Note how each model affects SLO design and incident response.

milestones.title: Professional SRE habits
milestones.outcome: Can maintain documentation, runbooks, and continuous improvement cycles.

tasks.title: Create a runbook template
tasks.description: Design a markdown template covering purpose, steps, rollback, and contacts.

tasks.title: Automate runbook generation
tasks.description: Write a small script that fills the template from a JSON incident payload.

tasks.title: Set up a weekly blameless review
tasks.description: Schedule a recurring calendar event and draft an agenda outline.

tasks.title: Document a knowledge‑base article
tasks.description: Pick a recurring issue (e.g., disk full) and write a concise KB article.

tasks.title: Connect with a senior SRE mentor
tasks.description: Reach out on LinkedIn, request a 30‑minute coffee chat about career growth.

milestones.title: Interview and job readiness
milestones.outcome: Can confidently discuss SRE topics and demonstrate portfolio work in interviews.

tasks.title: Practice whiteboard coding
tasks.description: Solve two algorithm problems (e.g., binary search, string reversal) on a virtual whiteboard.

tasks.title: Prepare STAR stories
tasks.description: Write three Situation‑Task‑Action‑Result narratives about incidents you handled.

tasks.title: Polish GitHub portfolio README
tasks.description: Add a summary, tech stack badges, and links to each project.

tasks.title: Mock interview with a peer
tasks.description: Conduct a 60‑minute mock SRE interview and record feedback.

tasks.title: Reflect on feedback and iterate
tasks.description: Update answers and documentation based on the mock interview insights.
